title: Prompt structured with XML tags and two examples
draft:
<instructions>
Classify each customer message into exactly one category: billing, bug, feature_request or other. Reply with the category name only, in lowercase.
</instructions>

<examples>
<example>
Message: I was charged twice for my March invoice.
Category: billing
</example>
<example>
Message: The export button does nothing when I click it in Safari.
Category: bug
</example>
</examples>

<message>
{{message}}
</message>
preserveVerbatim:
Message: I was charged twice for my March invoice.
Category: billing

Message: The export button does nothing when I click it in Safari.
Category: bug
notes: Tags and examples kept; the result must not be wrapped in a code fence.
